acceptanceCriteria: The reviewer section names the sealed map path under `.corvint/changes/` and instructs `--target <bind sha>`, and a reviewer following it verbatim at the seal head gets exit 0 from `cem report`.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent reviewer leg of V1-0146 (PR #102, extracted v0.7.0 build 46 archive, fresh clone at seal head 165e2d7). Section 6 (DOGFOOD.md:419-425) and step 8 name `.corvint/change.cem.json` and HEAD; at 165e2d7 the verbatim command exits 2 (cannot read CEM map) and `--target HEAD` exits 1 because the seal rename is in the patch.
